decision: Parent commit is exactly 58bb4183a9557b8b8b069552813db9530cb848b0.
Materialize TRAIN and CALIBRATION only; never create TEST output.
TRAIN and CALIBRATION live in separate directories.
Only source MiD TRAIN evidence may fit candidate models; R4 synthetic rows are interface witnesses only.
P_GEW/W_GEW are explicit weight columns and never X features.
H_ID/HP_ID/P_ID/W_ID are keys/provenance and never X features.
ST_WOTAG and saison map to scenario weekday/season analogues; month provenance-only, holiday deferred.
Canonical source resource categories preserve ownership/access separation and top-coding.
Optional context missingness never causes silent target-row deletion.
Chain transitions are eligible transitions intersected with full-functional person-days.
All DIRECT_TEMPORAL_VALID rows retained even when transition context is unresolved.
Raw wegkm universe is primary; expanded wegkm_imp table is report-only sensitivity.
km_routing is absent from all materialized schemas.
Observed/chosen mode, route and execution fields are absent.
Observed upstream outcomes may condition downstream fitting only as explicitly tagged source analogues.
Categorical vocabularies are learned from TRAIN only; CAL/runtime unseen -> __UNSEEN__.
Canonical UTF-8 LF CSV with fixed sort order and byte SHA256.
CAL materialization is evaluation/selection-only and cannot enter fitting.
TEST remains sealed; F3.2a verifier must reject TEST dataset declarations.
Actual materializer/encoders are F3.2b; no training in F3.2a.
